_about: One advising season = the advising and registration period for one upcoming term. Copy this file to start the next season (for example 2027-fall.json), change the dates and links, and keep `draft: true` until it is ready. Fields ending in `Html` are rendered as HTML (links, <b>), everything else as plain text. See README › Academic advising pages.

hero.title: Advising for Spring 2027
tldrHtml: Book a meeting with me between Oct 12 and Oct 21. We meet in NH293. If you would rather meet on Teams, book the time first and then email me to ask.
Before the meeting, update your Academic Plan and build a Saved Schedule for Spring 2027 in Workday. If you come without them, I will cancel the meeting.
Request any prerequisite overrides now. The instructor has to approve them.
I remove your advising hold after we meet.
Register at your time: seniors Oct 21, juniors Oct 22, sophomores Oct 26, first-years Oct 27.

prepare.title: Come with your plan already in Workday
prepare.ruleText: Our meeting is for reviewing your plan. If you arrive without an updated Academic Plan and a Saved Schedule, I will cancel the appointment and you will need to book a new one. Your advising hold stays on until we meet.

steps.titleHtml: Check your Academic Progress and note which requirements are still open. Use the course maps below to see what comes next.
Update your Academic Plan for Spring 2027, and beyond if you can.

Build a Saved Schedule for Spring 2027 with your first choices plus a couple of alternates. For a course with a lab, pick one lecture section and one lab section. The section letters do not have to match.
Request prerequisite overrides now. The course instructor has to approve them before you can register.

prepare.after: Bring your laptop and any questions about minors, internships, summer courses or study abroad. If you changed majors or are switching advisors, email me.

dates.registrationNoteHtml: At your time, open your Saved Schedule and click Register. Full classes may put you on a waitlist. Registration schedule · How to register (PDF) · Waitlists (PDF)
events: Workday workshop, Meeter Center Lecture Hall
Advising days, no classes. Help table outside SC 360, 1:00 to 4:30 PM
dates.eventsNoteHtml: Juniors and seniors: if you plan to walk at Commencement in May and will finish by December 2027, apply to graduate in Workday. How to apply (PDF)

help: Spring 2027 CS, Data, Math and Stat sections (times, instructors and descriptions, kept by Prof. Ken Arnold)
CS department advising page (which courses run in fall and which in spring)
Math and Statistics advising (with their yearly course schedule)
GitHub profile examples for building your portfolio
Questions? Stop by NH293 or email me.

nextTerm._about: Courses with sections next term, shown as a tag on the course map. Taken from Ken Arnold's advising page. A course gets a plain 'Spring 2027' tag when the catalog also says it runs every spring (its `offered` field in the catalog file); it gets 'Spring 2027 (unofficial)' when only Ken's list says so, e.g. alternate-year or 'varies' courses. Update or delete this block each season.
